top_signals.title: Bessent moves to curb Treasury yields, putting new pressure on Warsh's Fed
top_signals.summary: Treasury's move to buy back more long-term debt cooled a bond selloff, but economists warn it could raise new inflation and independence questions for the Fed
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: JPMorgan Sees Credibility Risk in Treasury’s Bond Buybacks
top_signals.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. strategists warned that markets may view the US Treasury’s surprise effort to curb long-term borrowing costs as lacking credibility, potentially pushing up the term premium and yields over time.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: RBI’s Net Short Dollar Position ‘Very Manageable,’ Malhotra Says
top_signals.summary: The Reserve Bank of India’s net short forward-dollar position remains “very manageable,” Governor Sanjay Malhotra said, citing earlier liquidity swaps and recent measures to bolster the balance of payments.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Activities of U.S. Affiliates of Foreign Multinational Enterprises, 2024
top_signals.summary: Majority-owned U.S. affiliates of foreign multinational enterprises employed 8.57 million workers in the United States in 2024, a 0.2 percent increase from 8.56 million workers in 2023, according to statistics on U.S. affiliate operations and finances released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis.
